THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Revocation Order under Section 39 (1)

By the Order No. 309 of 2017 dated 22.11.2017 made under theProviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460)and published in the Gazette Extra Ordinary No. 2047/13 dated28.11.2017 the land Specified more fully in the Schedule below wasvested in the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka.

But the possession of the said land has not yet been taken for andon behalf of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. Therefore,I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 39 (1) ofthe Land Acquisition Act, do hereby revoke the Order made in respectof the Land specified more fully in the aforesaid vesting Order No.309 of 2017 of 22.11.2017 published in the Gazette Extra-OrdinaryNo. 2047/13 dated 28.11.2017.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
My Reference No.: 4-3/15/2017/VE/363.Divisional Secretary’s No.: YAKI/LND/01/03/14 - II.Ministry of Land and Parliamentary Reforms“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla,22nd July, 2018.
